channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Mary Peltola oo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Alaska, Dan Sullivan oo laga adkaaday
item.description: Musharaxa Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Mary Peltola ayaa ka adkaatay Senator Dan Sullivan oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Jamhuuriga, iyadoo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee gobolka Alaska, kaas oo ahaa doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee Golaha Guurtida ee la go'aamiyo, sida ay saadaaliyeen warbaahinta Mareykanka.

item.title: Connor Bedard oo dhaawac la baxay, Blackhawks oo 6-3 ku garaacay Maple Leafs
item.description: Xiddigga kooxda Chicago Blackhawks Connor Bedard ayaa Talaadadii dhaawac ku ah garoonka ka baxay xilli uu socday kulan ay kooxdiisu 6-3 kaga adkaatay Toronto Maple Leafs horyaalka NHL.

item.title: Nin Pakistani ah oo 27 sano iyo badh lagu xukumay qorshe lagu doonayay in lagu dilo siyaasiyiin Mareykan ah
item.description: Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taal Brooklyn ayaa Talaadadii 330 bilood oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Asif Merchant, oo u dhashay Pakistan, kaddib markii lagu helay qorshe dil oo uu sheegay inuu ka dambeeyay Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, Donald Trump-na uu ka mid ahaa bartilmaameedyada.

item.title: Stojakovic oo 46 dhibcood dhaliyay, Illinois oo 99-78 ku garaacday Duke
item.description: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Illinois, oo kaalinta 10-aad ah, ayaa Talaadadii 99-78 kaga adkaatay Duke oo kaalinta 5-aad ah garoonkeeda Cameron Indoor Stadium, iyadoo Andrej Stojakovic uu dhaliyay 46 dhibcood.

item.title: Mareykanka oo 2-0 ku garaacay Haiti kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee Pochettino
item.description: Xulka Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cincinnati 2-0 kaga adkaaday Haiti, isagoo isugeyn ahaan 8-0 ugu gudbay semi-finalka CONCACAF Nations League, kulankaas oo ahaa kii ugu dambeeyay ee tababare Mauricio Pochettino.

item.title: Nin Irish ah oo New York lagu soo oogay burburinta diyaarad milatari oo Mareykan ah garoonka Shannon
item.description: Golaha garsoorka ee magaalada New York ayaa dacwad ku soo oogay Daithi O'Corrain, oo 48 jir ah kana soo jeeda Ireland, kaddib markii xeer-ilaalinta Mareykanku ay ku eedeysay inuu faas ku burburiyay diyaarad milatari oo C-130 ah oo la dhigay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Shannon.

item.title: Nin 25 jir ah oo lagu soo oogay isku day dil kadib weerarkii darawalka Soomaaliga ah ee Minnesota
item.description: Xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta degmada Hennepin ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa Talaadadii eedeymo isku day dil iyo afduub gaari ku soo oogay Samit Apurva Patel, oo 25 jir ah, kaddib weerar loo geystay Maxamed Yuusuf, darawal Uber oo Soomaali-Maraykan ah.

item.title: Uruguay oo 5-0 ku garaacday Jamhuuriyadda Dominican, Valverde oo gool qurux badan dhaliyay
item.description: Xulka Uruguay ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Maldonado 5-0 kaga adkaaday Jamhuuriyadda Dominican ciyaar saaxiibtinimo ah, taasoo ahayd guushii labaad ee tababare Diego Forlán laba kulan gudahood.

item.title: Golaha Nabadda oo uga digay Golaha Ammaanka in xabbad-joojinta Gaza ay khatar ugu jirto burbur
item.description: Golaha Nabadda (Board of Peace) oo Mareykanku taageero ayaa Talaadadii warbixintiisii sannadeed ee ugu horreysay u gudbiyay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo uga digay in heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta Gaza ee 2025 uu burburi karo haddii aan tallaabooyin degdeg ah la qaadin.

item.title: Argentina oo 7-0 ku burburisay Costa Rica, guushii ugu horreysay kaddib fariisashada Messi
item.description: Xulka Argentina ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Mario Alberto Kempes ee magaalada Córdoba 7-0 kaga adkaaday Costa Rica ciyaar saaxiibtinimo ah, iyadoo Nico Paz, Julián Álvarez iyo Franco Mastantuono ay mid kasta laba gool dhaliyeen.

item.title: Houston Dash oo Seb Hines u magacaawday tababaraha cusub
item.description: Kooxda kubadda cagta haweenka ee Houston Dash, oo ka ciyaarta horyaalka NWSL ee Mareykanka, ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday inay tababare cusub u magacawday Seb Hines, oo hore Orlando Pride ugu hoggaamiyay laba koob sannadkii 2024.

item.title: Kuwait oo sheegtay weerarro drone ah, xiisadda Iran iyo Mareykanka oo sii kordhaysa
item.description: Ciidamada Kuwait ayaa Talaadadii habeennimo sheegay in difaaca hawadu uu ka jawaabayo weerarro drone ah, saacado kaddib markii Mareykanku uu weeraray goob gantaallo oo ku taalla jasiiradda Qeshm ee Iran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Humphries iyo Van Gerwen oo u gudbay wareegga 16-ka ee Grand Slam of Darts
item.description: Luke Humphries iyo Michael van Gerwen ayaa Talaadadii u gudbay wareegga 16-ka ciyaaryahan ee tartanka Grand Slam of Darts, kaddib guulo ay ka gaareen kulamadoodii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga kooxaha.

item.title: Northern Ireland oo markii ugu horreysay u dallacday League A ee Nations League
item.description: Northern Ireland ayaa Talaadadii Budapest 1-1 la gashay Hungary, iyadoo Justin Devenny uu dhaliyay gool qurux badan oo ka dhigay kooxda koowaad ee kooxda B2, kuna dallaciyay heerka ugu sarreeya ee UEFA Nations League.

item.title: Websaydhka Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ee Xeegada Barafka oo la jabsaday kaddib mamnuucidda Ruushka
item.description: Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ee Xeegada Barafka (IIHF) ayaa sheegay in websaydhkiisa Talaadadii lagu qaaday weerar internet, kaas oo u muuqday mid looga jawaabayo go'aankii Ruushka looga reebay Horyaalka Adduunka ee Dhallinyarada 2026-27.

item.title: Olimpia Milano oo 91-77 ku garaacday Crvena Zvezda, soo afjartay sagaal guuldarro oo isku xiga
item.description: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Olimpia Milano ayaa Talaadadii wareegga 12-aad ee EuroLeague 91-77 kaga adkaatay Crvena Zvezda ee Serbia, taasoo soo afjartay sagaal guuldarro oo ay Yurub isku xigxiga kala kulantay.

item.title: Josh Hokit oo dalbaday ciyaar celis ah, Gane oo kor ugu kacay liisaska pound-for-pound
item.description: Feeryahanka Mareykanka Josh Hokit ayaa Talaadadii dalbaday in mar kale lala ciyaarsiiyo Ciryl Gane, isagoo sheegay in farta Gane ay ishiisa gashay bilowgii dagaalkii UFC 334, halka Gane uu kor ugu kacay liisaska pound-for-pound, sida ay werisay CBS Sports iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Norway oo 3-2 kaga soo laabatay Denmark, Haaland oo u gudbiyay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka
item.description: Norway ayaa Talaadadii Copenhagen 3-2 kaga adkaatay Denmark kaddib markii ay 2-0 ka dambeysay, iyadoo Erling Haaland uu rigoore waqtiga dheeraadka ah ku dhaliyay goolka u gudbiyay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka ee UEFA Nations League.

item.title: Bosnia oo 2-1 kaga soo laabatay Romania, Sweden oo 1-1 la gashay Poland
item.description: Bosnia iyo Herzegovina ayaa Talaadadii 2-1 kaga adkaatay Romania, halka Sweden ay 1-1 la gashay Poland, labadaas kulan oo ahaa kuwii ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda B4 ee UEFA Nations League.

item.title: Nations League: 8-da xul ee u gudbay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka oo la ogaaday
item.description: Wareegga siddeed dhammaadka ee UEFA Nations League 2026/27 ayaa dhammaystirmay Talaadadii, kaddib markii Norway ay noqotay xulkii ugu dambeeyay ee u gudba, iyadoo ku biirtay Belgium, England, France, Germany, Netherlands, Portugal iyo Spain.

item.title: Nvidia oo soo bandhigtay natiijooyin xooggan, guddiguna ma soo celinayo Jensen Huang
item.description: Shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Talaadadii soo bandhigtay natiijooyin maaliyadeed oo ka sarreeya filashada suuqa, iyadoo sheegtay inaysan dib u magacaabayn maamulihii hore Jensen Huang, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Parrott oo laba rigoore dhaliyay, Ireland oo 3-0 ku garaacday Kosovo
item.description: Jamhuuriyadda Ireland ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Aviva ee Dublin 3-0 kaga adkaatay Kosovo oo 10 ciyaaryahan ku dhammaysatay kulanka, iyadoo Troy Parrott uu dhaliyay laba rigoore, taasoo u gudbisay ciyaaraha play-off-ka ee UEFA Nations League.

item.title: Portugal oo 3-2 kaga adkaatay Wales, Carlos Forbs oo dhaliyay goolka guusha
item.description: Xulka Portugal ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cardiff 3-2 kaga adkaaday Wales kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga kooxaha ee UEFA Nations League, iyadoo Carlos Forbs, oo ciyaarta ku soo galay beddel, uu dhaliyay goolka guusha.

item.title: Mali oo 2-0 ku garaacday Rwanda, 6 xul oo u gudbay AFCON 2027
item.description: Mali ayaa Talaadadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Rwanda, halka Burkina Faso ay 3-1 ku garaacday Mauritania, labaduba waxay xaqiijiyeen kaalintooda Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027, sida ay werisay L'Équipe.

item.title: Matan Kahana oo loo doortay guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Israa'iil
item.description: Baarlamaanka Israa'iil ee Knesset-ka ayaa Talaadadii guddoomiye u doortay Matan Kahana, oo xulafo la ah Gadi Eisenkot, isagoo helay 66 cod oo ka mid ah 120-ka xubnood, taasoo wiiqaysa awoodda Ra'iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera iyo CNN.

item.title: Mareykanka oo duqeeyay jasiiradda Qeshm ee Iran kadib markii miinooyin ay ku dhaceen shan markab oo Hormuz mara
item.description: Diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii fiidkii duqeeyay goobaha gantaallada laga rido ee jasiiradda Qeshm ee koonfurta Iran, kadib markii ugu yaraan shan markab ay ku dhaceen miinooyin badeed oo ku yaal Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo Iran ay isla maalintaas weerar ku qaadday xarun Mareykan oo ku taal Bahrain.

item.title: Žalgiris oo waqti dheeraad ah 117-114 kaga adkaatay Bayern Munich, Carsen Edwards oo 32 dhibcood dhaliyay
item.description: Kooxda kubbadda koleyga ee Žalgiris Kaunas ayaa Talaadadii kulan EuroLeague ah oo gaaray waqti dheeraad ah 117-114 kaga adkaatay FC Bayern Munich, iyadoo ciyaaryahankii hore ee Bayern, Carsen Edwards, uu go'aamiyay kulanka.

item.title: Libya iyo Tunisia oo 1-1 ku kala baxay, ciyaartoyda Tunisia oo garoonka uga baxay mudaharaad rigoore
item.description: Kulanka isreebreebka AFCON 2027 ee Libya iyo Tunisia oo Talaadadii lagu ciyaaray Tripoli ayaa ku dhammaaday 1-1, kadib markii ciyaartoyda Tunisia ay dhowr daqiiqo garoonka uga baxeen iyagoo ka cabanaya rigoore muran dhaliyay oo la siiyay Libya.

item.title: Nasser Al-Khelaïfi oo garsoorayaasha u sheegay inuusan waxba ka ogeyn "ciidanka dijitaalka" ee PSG
item.description: Madaxweynaha Paris Saint-Germain, Nasser Al-Khelaïfi, ayaa bishii September laba garsoore oo baaritaan ay dhegeysteen isagoo ah markhaati la caawiyo, wuxuuna sheegay inuusan waxba ka ogeyn akoonnada baraha bulshada ee loo yaqaan "ciidanka dijitaalka" ee naadiga, sida ay wariyeen AFP iyo L'Équipe.

item.title: Ukraine oo sheegtay inay burburisay qeyb ka mid ah buundada Kerch ee Ruushka ku xirta Crimea
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in diyaarado drone ah iyo gantaallo Ukraine ah ay garaaceen buundada Kerch ee isku xirta Ruushka iyo jasiiradda Crimea ee la haysto, isagoo howlgalka ku tilmaamay mid aan horay loo arag.
